name: feedback-brief
title: Feedback evidence brief
for_each: select id,name from datasets order by name

sections.title: Dataset and purpose
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose from datasets where id=$1

sections.title: Accepted themes
sections.sql: select v.* from v_theme_volume v join datasets d on d.name=v.dataset where d.id=$1
sections.note: Theme share uses all responses in this dataset. A response can have several themes. Counts are descriptive, not causal.

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due_on from actions where dataset_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

name: action-register
title: Feedback action register
for_each: select id,name from datasets order by name

sections.title: Commitments and evidence
sections.sql: select a.reference,t.name theme,a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status,a.evidence,a.closed_on from actions a join themes t on t.id=a.theme_id where a.dataset_id=$1 order by a.due_on

name: retention-review
title: Personal information retention review
for_each: select id,name from datasets order by name

sections.title: Recorded purpose and hold
sections.note: Internal review worksheet. An operator decides what to retain or remove. A legal hold prevents routine disposal; this system never deletes.

sections.title: Review coverage
sections.sql: select count(*) responses,count(*) filter(where privacy_reviewed) reviewed from responses where dataset_id=$1
